meta.title: Financhx — Financial Operating System
meta.description: Enterprise software platform to centralize, automate and audit financial operations. Reduce manual processes and connect bank statements with invoicing in real time.

hero.sub: Financhx centralizes bank statements, automates reconciliation rules and delivers real-time auditability — without spreadsheets.

problem.title: Manual reconciliation is the bottleneck slowing your finances.
problem.sub: Every month, your accounting team loses dozens of hours crossing banks, invoicing and collection reports. Financhx eliminates that friction.

problems.title: Scattered financial sources
problems.desc: Banks, corporate wallets, payment gateways and invoicing systems operate in isolation. Teams download statements manually every month.
problems.tag: No single source of financial truth.

problems.title: Manual reconciliation in spreadsheets
problems.desc: Dependence on spreadsheets with fragile macros creates bottlenecks and exponential human error. Hundreds of hours lost per month.

problems.title: Errors and gaps that are hard to detect
problems.desc: Bank commissions, withholdings or duplicated charges go unnoticed until the balance close, when the damage is already hard to reverse.

problems.title: Non-existent traceability and audit
problems.desc: Reconstructing who authorized an entry, what document backed it up or what date it occurred requires long chains of emails and outdated files.
problems.tag: Impossible to pass audits without friction and delay.

problems.title: Repetitive processes that wear teams down
problems.desc: Qualified accounting teams spend most of their day copying and comparing data instead of strategic financial analysis.
problems.tag: Team burnout and chronic financial procrastination.

platform.title: Three modules. One financial operating system.
platform.sub: Financhx is not just a reconciliation tool. It is an integrated operating infrastructure for the financial area of your company.

modules.name: Reconcile
modules.desc: Automated engine for bank vs invoice reconciliation. Detects exact matches, partial differences and unidentified movements with configurable rules.

modules.name: Optimize
modules.desc: Real-time cash flow analysis, payment projections and treasury management. Convert raw data into actionable insights for your CFO.

modules.name: Ledger
modules.desc: Immutable accounting record with complete operation log, digital signature chain and integration with certified accounting systems.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Quick answers about the demo, the product and Financhx.

faqs.question: Does the demo process real reconciliations?
faqs.answer: No. The demo presents illustrative scenarios to explain a flow; the product is in development and does not yet process real operations.

faqs.question: What do the figures shown represent?
faqs.answer: They are sample data to illustrate the interface; they do not represent client operations or real results.

faqs.question: Is Financhx a bank or does it provide financial advice?
faqs.answer: No. Financhx develops software for business operations; it is not a banking entity, does not hold funds, and does not offer financial or tax advice.

faqs.question: Can you develop custom software?
faqs.answer: Yes. The digital engineering division accepts inquiries for web applications, internal systems, automation and enterprise integrations.

faqs.question: Does the demo read or send selected files?
faqs.answer: No. The current uploader only shows the name and size of the selected file. It does not read its content nor send it to a server.

faqs.question: Are the metrics real client results?
faqs.answer: No. The prototype figures are illustrative data; they do not represent real results or guarantee performance.

footer.tagline: Software to simplify, centralize and automate enterprise financial operations. Reducing manual processes and providing comprehensive accounting traceability.
footer.disclaimer: Financhx is a software platform in development designed for operational management, movement reconciliation and administrative control of companies. Financhx is not a bank, regulated financial company, digital wallet, nor an investment or fund custody platform.
